text_block_list.text:
One day, when I arrived at the training 
track――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No... Is there anything else we could 
improve on...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Oh my, good day. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, my race times have 
plateaued lately. Yet I'm struggling to 
come up with a good solution...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you were to give advice to your 
Umamusume, what sort of thing would you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Stamina and grit, you say...? I believed I 
had been keeping them in mind, but――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, no matter how much one trains, it 
can never truly be enough, can it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Advice received. I shall incorporate it 
into my training at once!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...A sprint dash, you say? Admittedly, I 
hadn't been paying that much conscious 
attention to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Still, to reach even greater heights, you 
have to plan your race strategy right from 
the start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Advice received. I shall incorporate it 
into my training routine at once!
